alt: The Fish Don’t Negotiate · Crew and controls. Trout sit in a row under a warm overhead wash. Their side profiles, hands, little panels and blue window fit in one vertical composition.
On Melancholy Hill · Porthole view of crew. Two drawn faces fit inside the rounded window. The curved frame and dim depth hold the hatch geometry together.
The Impossible Voyage · Crew in compartments. Crew gesture around the middle compartment. Painted bows, ribs and water line keep the cross-section fixed.
Original front-view arrangement with a centered chipped porthole, visible rock notch, lamp toggle below right, ballast slot below left and chart under glass.
The Fish Don’t Negotiate · Side cabin angle. One trout in a red garment occupies the console edge. The cool window leaves room to see what the fish is looking toward.
The Fish Don’t Negotiate · Crew and controls. Trout sit in a row under a warm overhead wash. Their side profiles, hands, little panels and blue window fit in one vertical composition.
On Melancholy Hill · Equipment and grating. Exposed pipes, grating and a diagonal sweep of light occupy the cabin. A nearby form makes the room feel cramped.
On Melancholy Hill · Fleet angle. A warm dark-red cockpit edge sits close while smaller lights separate the distant craft in deep cyan water.
On Melancholy Hill · Porthole view of crew. Two drawn faces fit inside the rounded window. The curved frame and dim depth hold the hatch geometry together.
The Impossible Voyage · Painted hull section. A row of people and a bank of pipes share a side-on painted compartment. A green water band belongs to the same frame.
The Impossible Voyage · Crew in compartments. Crew gesture around the middle compartment. Painted bows, ribs and water line keep the cross-section fixed.
The Impossible Voyage · Same cutaway, new blocking. Hands and positions change while the piping stays in the left compartment and the low water band remains visible.
Invention for Destruction · Hull under an arch. An etched oval hull and a pale beam sit under jagged rock. Vessel, clearance and cave all read together.
Invention for Destruction · Architectural set. Striped walls and archways carry the eye down the built space to a figure. The hatching remains distinct on both foreground and far surfaces.
Invention for Destruction · Figure against the set. A live performer appears against patterned set pieces. The stripes continue to describe the setting around the body.
One More Time · Control room. A cool, deep room uses arcs of consoles and a large central blue focal area. Furniture and screens lead to the same center.
One More Time · Console and performer. A blue-skinned figure shares the frame with a luminous control surface.
One More Time · Distant signal. Pools of colored lights radiate around a rounded gathering area in the city view.
Submarines · Aperture on paper. A drawn hand and round opening organize a sepia paper frame. Its hard rim divides the near surface from the interior field.
Submarines · Traced face. Uneven brown grain and lightly drawn lines give the portrait a rubbed, handled-paper quality.
Submarines · Search cones. Small dark forms and thin pale search cones cut through a grainy gray field.
Pyramid Song · Structures below water. Pale uprights and loose lines recede into a muted blue-green field.
Pyramid Song · Light and line. A small pool of light sits where a pale line continues into dark space.
Pyramid Song · Dark interior. A lit doorway edge picks out part of a submerged structure; the light stops before the rest of the room can be read.
Dashboard · Tabletop staging. A seated sailor and the people around him orient toward familiar objects on a battered table in a dim room.
Dashboard · Eyeline toward model. The sailor lowers his eyes toward small pale forms and a rod. A hand-sized thing sets the shot’s scale.
Dashboard · Exterior scale change. A fishing boat rides on mottled water beneath a painted-looking sky.
Mind Game trailer · Photographic register. A close face has a photographic texture and uneven light. Its scale gives a stable bodily anchor.
Mind Game trailer · Graphic register. An angular blue face cuts across strongly horizontal motion marks.
Mind Game trailer · Mass and direction. A long structure tilts across a dark rushing-looking field. A clear diagonal supplies a direction of force.
This Land Is Mine · Establishing layout. A small figure crosses a flat landscape. Several rows of trees establish depth using scale.
This Land Is Mine · Fixed stage. Trees frame a profile figure over a narrow patterned strip of ground.
This Land Is Mine · Changed blocking. Two figures occupy the same strip and bracketed tree stage. The positions change while the ground motif stays.
Water Fountain · Practical room. An open turquoise frame, suspended cords and face-like furniture leave the set construction readable.
Water Fountain · Object as display. A small CRT with visible external wires holds a bold, simple house graphic.
Water Fountain · Timed repetition. Two performers mirror bent-knee poses against repeated bars. The shared pose carries a pulse across the set.
Vesuvius · Held album cover. An upright red-and-dark geometric figure, nested squares and small written marks share a single static cover.
The Rifle’s Spiral · Hinged miniature. A hinged dark lid becomes a tiny stage with stars and crescent cut shapes.
The Rifle’s Spiral · Physical silhouette. A gray rabbit form with a large carved silhouette fills a dark miniature space edged by small marks and light.
The Rifle’s Spiral · Detail of material. A carved profile and visible seams place the object on a tactile surface.
Song of the Sea · Sea scene · Lighthouse interior. A blue upright space wraps around a stair. The round opening reads as a separate pool of blue.
Song of the Sea · Sea scene · Patterned object inside. A rounded ornamental fixture occupies a deep room. Its pale chalk-like marks hold together against darker framing.
Song of the Sea · Sea scene · Layered water. Wide rounded ribbons of blue and small circles carry motion without losing a strong two-dimensional arrangement.
Welcome to Trout Town · Submerged working space. An upright figure stands among posts and a bed of plants. Sun cuts down through the water.
Welcome to Trout Town · Resident at a counter. A fish works at a close counter under an amber shade. Framed papers, cups and hanging material make the room feel used.
Welcome to Trout Town · Outdoor landmarks. The upright resident and fish have a clear relation to trunks, bank and slanting light.
Something in the Kitchen · Corridor. A resident in work clothes stands near the camera with a fluorescent corridor and another figure behind.
Something in the Kitchen · Object at the counter. Workers face one another at hand distance. Colored square labels and the object’s place between hands make the counter legible.
The School of Fish · Chalkboard wall. An upright trout is framed next to a chalkboard, which holds one readable zone in the room.
The School of Fish · Classroom scale. The fish instructor and a portable chalkboard are in the same working space. Small pupils watch lower in frame.
Where the River Meets the Road · Boundary in water. A trout approaches hanging strands and a visible boundary across a soft blue space.
Where the River Meets the Road · Circular opening. A dark wet circle catches a suspended droplet. The rim makes a strong, recognizable threshold.
Where the River Meets the Road · Near water level. An inhabited small craft sits on dark reflective water. Its occupant’s head gives scale to the crossing.
Trading on the Current · Bell by the fish. A fish and a small brass bell share the near view above a stony bottom.
Trading on the Current · Shared table. Fish occupy different sides of a pale low counter in a dim underwater trading area.
